negatives.failure_signature: PowerShell interpreted a colon immediately after an interpolated branch variable as scoped-variable syntax, producing an invalid refspec after the x1 commit and push had already succeeded.
negatives.trigger_precondition: A source:destination refspec was placed in a double-quoted string as $branch:refs without braced interpolation.
negatives.recovery: Retained the failed fetch, reran only the proof command with ${branch} on both sides, and established clean local, upstream, remote-tracking, and fresh live-remote equality with 0/0 divergence.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Brace PowerShell variables that touch a colon in Git refspecs and separate commit or push success from later proof-command status.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the failed fetch supplied no equality evidence and x2 did not begin until the corrected proof passed

negatives.operation: first post-freeze Method Flow interface query
negatives.failure_signature: The runner rejected inherited append-method and append-witness command names; its current subcommands are record and witness.
negatives.trigger_precondition: Command names were recalled rather than copied from the runner interface already selected for the phase.
negatives.recovery: Retained both parser rejections, queried record and witness help, and used the exact current flags for subsequent ledger appends.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Use the complete skill and runner help as the command source of truth at each lifecycle boundary.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; argument parsing stopped before any Method Flow ledger mutation

boundary: Operational recovery never deletes a failure or converts same-owner process evidence into independent reproduction.
